profiles.bg.title: Default background
profiles.bg.profileHelp: Seats get this background when the profile is loaded (a deck's background wins).
profiles.bg.deckHelp: Seats get this background when the deck is loaded.
profiles.commander.label: Commander
profiles.commander.none: No commander found. The name is kept as typed.
profiles.commander.offline: Offline — type the commander's name; its art is found when you're back online.
profiles.commander.error: Commander search is unavailable. The name is kept as typed.
profiles.commanderArt.title: Set seat backgrounds to commanders
profiles.commanderArt.subtitle: Seats with a commander get its card art, unless they have a deck background or art picked by hand.
profiles.commanderArt.help: Background precedence: art picked by hand in this game, then the deck's background, then the commander's art (this option), then the profile's background. Works offline once the art has been loaded.
